scenarios.title: scenario-runner prompt creates the area worktree through placeholders
scenarios.notes: Risk: a loop branch literal returns, or the placeholder order flips. The text must hold the exact command `git worktree add "$TMPDIR/sdlc-<milestoneId>-<areaId>" -b <e2e area branch> <e2e branch>`. Try each variant: literal sdlc/<milestoneId>-e2e, swapped placeholders, placeholder with another spelling. Read the prompt file from disk, not only the test fixture.

scenarios.title: env-detector prompt reads the run branch through the placeholder and the parsed kind
scenarios.notes: Risk: one of the three <run branch> uses reverts to sdlc/run-<n>, or the sdlc/run-* glob returns. The text needs at least three <run branch> and the phrase 'a branch that parses as kind `run`'. The default format sdlc/{name} must stay allowed. Check that branches.py parse accepts a run branch under the default format so the phrase is true.

scenarios.title: milestone-writer prompt names e2e area, e2e and milestone branches through placeholders
scenarios.notes: Risk: one of the six milestone literals (sdlc/M-<n>) or sdlc/<id>-e2e remains. All three placeholders must appear. Try sdlc/M-1, sdlc/<id>-e2e-<area>, and a literal inside a code span or table.

scenarios.title: e2e-harness prompt names e2e and milestone branches through placeholders
scenarios.notes: Risk: sdlc/<milestoneId>-e2e or sdlc/M-<n> returns. Both <e2e branch> and <milestone branch> must appear.

scenarios.title: the branch literal guard fails on a bad sample and ignores allowed text
scenarios.notes: Risk: the guard passes for the wrong reason. LOOP_BRANCH_LITERAL must match sdlc/M-1, sdlc/run-2, sdlc/S-003 and the e2e forms. It must not match the allowed default sdlc/{name} in env-detector.md or the branches.py output that stripBranchesOutput removes. Run the whole prompts.test.mjs and the full npm test. Inject a literal into a scratch copy of each prompt and confirm its test fails.

tools.purpose: run branches.py parse and node --test in a scratch repo, and record exit codes and tree changes

riskReason: The slice adds only tests that read four prompt files, and a wrong result is easy to see and cheap to fix.
notes: No product script changes and no I/O boundary. Profiles are listed by priority: contract first, then cli. ui, i18n, http-api, async, concurrency, data and limits cannot observe prompt text. security is skipped because no input crosses a trust boundary.
